current_decision.message: Selected esp32_bmp280_v1 family version 1 with 'low_current' profile. Operating limits are supply 3.2–3.4 V, current capacity 1000 mA, ambient 10–35 °C, total bus capacitance 100 pF. These are family documented limits, not measured or guaranteed performance.

clauses.text: Configure the ESP32/BMP280 family with its low_current option.
clauses.reason: User explicitly requests the esp32_bmp280_v1 family with the 'low_current' profile which reduces I2C pull-up sink current to 10k ohms, matching documented options.

clauses.text: I accept the documented supply, temperature and bus-loading envelope.
clauses.reason: User accepts the documented supply voltage, current capacity, ambient temperature, and bus capacitance envelope as published for this family and profile, which are not measurements but operating limits.
